name: White Christmas
source:
Mamoru had planned to spend this winter vacation at home playing online games. However, on a whim, he went outside to look at the snow that had suddenly fallen.

[summarized from [url=http://www.geocities.jp/nanaminamo/white.htm]official page[/url]]
translation:
守原本打算整个寒假都待在家里玩网络游戏。然而一时兴起，他走出家门，想看看这场突如其来的雪。

[概述自[url=http://www.geocities.jp/nanaminamo/white.htm]官方页面[/url]]
